name: io.github.hs737/mcp-server-for-ynab
title: MCP Server for YNAB
description: Connect your AI assistant to YNAB. Read-only by default, with reversible opt-in writes.

environmentVariables.name: YNAB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: YNAB personal access token from app.ynab.com/settings/developer.

environmentVariables.name: YNAB_PLAN_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default plan (budget) id, so tools do not need it passed on every call.

environmentVariables.name: YNAB_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the write tools. Unset means read-only, and the write tools are absent from tools/list entirely.
